wedo_instance.description: The master protocol for WeDo-JSON artifacts, ensuring a shared thread of attention.

meta.philosophy: The WeDo is a todo we do together. Machine-readable status fields allow for synchronous alignment.

rules.status_mandate: Every task AND the root instance MUST include a 'status' field using the '[ ]', '[x]', or '[-]' syntax to mirror markdown checkboxes.
rules.evolution_mandate: Bespoke chrono-fractal WeDos (spread surface area) can be 'upgraded' into common boilerplates in the root/ directory (sharpened surface area) when their process logic is validated as reusable across agent generations.
rules.commit_pulse_mandate: DON'T FORGET TO COMMIT: Adhere to the Turn-by-Turn Commit Mandate. Every file version increment MUST be committed as its own independent technical strike via 'metagit_commit.py'.

tasks.description: Audit all json/wedo/ templates against the status_mandate.
Synchronize status field updates across all active session WeDo instances.
